LineageEdgeAnswer.description: One way an input influences an output of the job.

input_column.description: For a column edge, the input column; for a parameter edge, the parameter name such as @AsOfDate; else null.
input_column.title: Input Column

input_kind.description: column: a column of one of the job's input tables; parameter: a job parameter such as @AsOfDate; constant: a literal in the code; generated: a value the engine makes, such as an IDENTITY key or a load timestamp.
input_kind.title: Input Kind

input_table.description: For a column edge, the job INPUT table it belongs to, schema-qualified (trace through temp tables and work data sets back to the job's inputs); else null.
input_table.title: Input Table

kind.description: derives: the input's value flows into the output column; filters: it decides which rows appear (WHERE, JOIN ON, HAVING, IN=, subsetting IF); ranks: it decides which row survives (ORDER BY in a ROW_NUMBER, NODUPKEY, FIRST./LAST.).
kind.title: Kind

lines.description: Line numbers in the legacy file that show the edge.
lines.title: Lines

output_column.description: The output column the edge feeds; null for an edge that decides which rows appear (a filter) or which row survives (a ranking).
output_column.title: Output Column

output_table.description: The job's output table, schema-qualified, e.g. rpt.claims_summary.
output_table.title: Output Table

transform.description: A few words on the logic, e.g. 'UPPER(RTRIM(lob_code))'.
transform.title: Transform

LineageEdgeAnswer.title: LineageEdgeAnswer

notes.description: Anything a reviewer should know, such as a column whose lineage is uncertain. Empty when there is nothing to add.

request.prompt:
Job T04: usp_build_claims_summary (tsql), file estate/tsql/T04_usp_build_claims_summary.sql.
Open claims with paid, reserve and incurred to date.
Parameters: AsOfDate.

Code:
  1 | /*==============================================================================
  2 |   Job       rpt.usp_build_claims_summary
  3 |   Purpose   Open claims summary for the claims MI pack: one row per claim that
  4 |             is open or reopened at the reporting date, with paid, case reserve
  5 |             and incurred to date.
  6 |   Author    JMcK
  7 |   Run by    CLM_MI_NIGHTLY, after the claims extracts have loaded
  8 |   Output    rpt.claims_summary (full refresh)
  9 | 
 10 |   Change log
 11 |     2014-09-03  JMcK  Initial version (CR-0871)
 12 |     2015-02-17  JMcK  Policy number from the policy extract (CR-0933)
 13 |     2017-06-26  AOS   Claim reference for the handler worklist (CR-1188)
 14 |     2018-11-05  RD    Case reserves by type, current reserve and incurred (CR-1402)
 15 |     2020-03-30  AOS   Reopened claims reported with the open book (INC-2207)
 16 |     2021-08-12  RD    Days open and reported period for the ageing tabs (CR-1655)
 17 | ==============================================================================*/
 18 | SET NOCOUNT ON;
 19 | GO
 20 | IF OBJECT_ID(N'rpt.claims_summary', N'U') IS NULL
 21 | CREATE TABLE rpt.claims_summary (
 22 |     claim_id           INT            NOT NULL,
 23 |     claim_number       VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
 24 |     claim_ref          VARCHAR(40)    NULL,      -- LOB/claim number/handler
 25 |     policy_id          INT            NOT NULL,
 26 |     policy_number      VARCHAR(20)    NULL,
 27 |     lob_code           VARCHAR(5)     NOT NULL,
 28 |     status             VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 29 |     handler_code       VARCHAR(8)     NULL,
 30 |     loss_date          DATE           NOT NULL,
 31 |     loss_date_text     VARCHAR(10)    NOT NULL,  -- dd/mm/yyyy for the MI pack
 32 |     reported_date      DATE           NOT NULL,
 33 |     reported_period    CHAR(6)        NOT NULL,  -- yyyymm
 34 |     days_open          INT            NOT NULL,
 35 |     n_payments         INT            NOT NULL,
 36 |     total_paid         DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 37 |     indemnity_reserve  DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 38 |     expense_reserve    DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 39 |     current_reserve    DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 40 |     incurred           DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 41 |     as_of_date         DATE           NOT NULL,
 42 |     CONSTRAINT pk_rpt_claims_summary PRIMARY KEY (claim_id)
 43 | );
 44 | GO
 45 | CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE rpt.usp_build_claims_summary
 46 |     @AsOfDate DATE
 47 | AS
 48 | BEGIN
 49 |     SET NOCOUNT ON;
 50 | 
 51 |     DECLARE @job_name       VARCHAR(128) = 'rpt.usp_build_claims_summary',
 52 |             @rows           INT,
 53 |             @snapshot_date  DATE,
 54 |             @err_msg        NVARCHAR(4000),
 55 |             @err_no         INT;
 56 | 
 57 |     BEGIN TRY
 58 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'start', @status = 'STARTED';
 59 | 
 60 |         /* Open book: claims open or reopened and notified by the reporting date */
 61 |         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#open_claims') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #open_claims;
 62 | 
 63 |         SELECT  c.claim_id,
 64 |                 c.claim_number,
 65 |                 c.policy_id,
 66 |                 UPPER(RTRIM(c.lob_code))    AS lob_code,
 67 |                 c.status,
 68 |                 c.handler_code,
 69 |                 c.loss_date,
 70 |                 c.reported_date
 71 |         INTO    #open_claims
 72 |         FROM    stg.claims c WITH (NOLOCK)
 73 |         WHERE   c.status IN ('OPEN', 'REOPENED')
 74 |           AND   c.reported_date <= @AsOfDate;
 75 | 
 76 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
 77 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'open claims', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
 78 | 
 79 |         /* Case reserve per claim and reserve type: the latest entry on or before
 80 |            the reporting date (a second entry on the same day is a correction) */
 81 |         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#reserve') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #reserve;
 82 | 
 83 |         SELECT  x.claim_id,
 84 |                 x.reserve_type,
 85 |                 x.reserve_amount
 86 |         INTO    #reserve
 87 |         FROM   (SELECT  r.claim_id,
 88 |                         r.reserve_type,
 89 |                         r.reserve_amount,
 90 |                         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.claim_id, r.reserve_type
 91 |                                            ORDER BY r.reserve_date DESC, r.reserve_id DESC) AS rn
 92 |                 FROM    stg.claim_reserves r WITH (NOLOCK)
 93 |                 JOIN    #open_claims oc ON oc.claim_id = r.claim_id
 94 |                 WHERE   r.reserve_date <= @AsOfDate) x
 95 |         WHERE   x.rn = 1;
 96 | 
 97 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
 98 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'case reserves', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
 99 | 
100 |         /* Paid to date and case reserves per claim */
101 |         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#money') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #money;
102 | 
103 |         SELECT  oc.claim_id,
104 |                 COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id)    AS n_payments,
105 |                 ISNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0)        AS total_paid,
106 |                 ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN r.reserve_type = 'INDEMNITY' THEN r.reserve_amount END), 0) AS indemnity_reserve,
107 |                 ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN r.reserve_type = 'EXPENSE'   THEN r.reserve_amount END), 0) AS expense_reserve
108 |         INTO    #money
109 |         FROM    #open_claims oc
110 |         LEFT JOIN stg.claim_payments p WITH (NOLOCK)
111 |                ON p.claim_id = oc.claim_id
112 |               AND p.payment_date <= @AsOfDate
113 |         LEFT JOIN #reserve r
114 |                ON r.claim_id = oc.claim_id
115 |         GROUP BY oc.claim_id;
116 | 
117 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
118 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'paid and reserves', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
119 | 
120 |         /* Policy number from the latest policy extract on or before the reporting date */
121 |         SELECT  @snapshot_date = MAX(ps.snapshot_date)
122 |         FROM    stg.policy_snapshots ps WITH (NOLOCK)
123 |         WHERE   ps.snapshot_date <= @AsOfDate;
124 | 
125 |         BEGIN TRANSACTION;
126 | 
127 |         TRUNCATE TABLE rpt.claims_summary;
128 | 
129 |         INSERT INTO rpt.claims_summary
130 |                (claim_id, claim_number, claim_ref, policy_id, policy_number, lob_code,
131 |                 status, handler_code, loss_date, loss_date_text, reported_date,
132 |                 reported_period, days_open, n_payments, total_paid, indemnity_reserve,
133 |                 expense_reserve, current_reserve, incurred, as_of_date)
134 |         SELECT  oc.claim_id,
135 |                 oc.claim_number,
136 |                 oc.lob_code + '/' + oc.claim_number + '/' + oc.handler_code,
137 |                 oc.policy_id,
138 |                 ps.policy_number,
139 |                 oc.lob_code,
140 |                 oc.status,
141 |                 oc.handler_code,
142 |                 oc.loss_date,
143 |                 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), oc.loss_date, 103),
144 |                 oc.reported_date,
145 |                 CONVERT(CHAR(6), oc.reported_date, 112),
146 |                 DATEDIFF(DAY, oc.reported_date, @AsOfDate),
147 |                 m.n_payments,
148 |                 m.total_paid,
149 |                 m.indemnity_reserve,
150 |                 m.expense_reserve,
151 |                 m.indemnity_reserve + m.expense_reserve,
152 |                 m.total_paid + m.indemnity_reserve + m.expense_reserve,
153 |                 @AsOfDate
154 |         FROM    #open_claims oc
155 |         JOIN    #money m
156 |                 ON m.claim_id = oc.claim_id
157 |         LEFT JOIN stg.policy_snapshots ps WITH (NOLOCK)
158 |                ON ps.policy_id = oc.policy_id
159 |               AND ps.snapshot_date = @snapshot_date;
160 | 
161 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
162 | 
163 |         COMMIT TRANSACTION;
164 | 
165 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'rpt.claims_summary', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
166 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'SUCCESS';
167 |     END TRY
168 |     BEGIN CATCH
169 |         IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
170 | 
171 |         SELECT  @err_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
172 |                 @err_no  = ERROR_NUMBER();
173 | 
174 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'FAILED',
175 |              @message = @err_msg, @error_number = @err_no;
176 |         THROW;
177 |     END CATCH
178 | END;
179 | GO

Input tables:
- stg.claims: claim_id INT, claim_number VARCHAR(20), policy_id INT, customer_id INT, lob_code VARCHAR(5), loss_date DATE, reported_date DATE, status VARCHAR(12), closed_date DATE, cause_code VARCHAR(10), handler_code VARCHAR(8), description NVARCHAR(200), _row_seq INT
- stg.claim_payments: payment_id INT, claim_id INT, payment_date DATE, amount DECIMAL(12,2), payment_type VARCHAR(12), payee_type VARCHAR(12), _row_seq INT
- stg.claim_reserves: reserve_id INT, claim_id INT, reserve_date DATE, reserve_type VARCHAR(12), reserve_amount DECIMAL(12,2), _row_seq INT
- stg.policy_snapshots: snapshot_date DATE, policy_id INT, policy_number VARCHAR(20), customer_id INT, product_code VARCHAR(10), broker_code VARCHAR(10), inception_date DATE, expiry_date DATE, status VARCHAR(12), cancellation_date DATE, annual_premium DECIMAL(12,2), currency CHAR(3), sum_insured DECIMAL(14,2), payment_frequency VARCHAR(10), vehicle_reg VARCHAR(12), ncd_years INT, _row_seq INT

Output tables:
- rpt.claims_summary: claim_id INT, claim_number VARCHAR(20), claim_ref VARCHAR(40), policy_id INT, policy_number VARCHAR(20), lob_code VARCHAR(5), status VARCHAR(12), handler_code VARCHAR(8), loss_date DATE, loss_date_text VARCHAR(10), reported_date DATE, reported_period CHAR(6), days_open INT, n_payments INT, total_paid DECIMAL(14,2), indemnity_reserve DECIMAL(14,2), expense_reserve DECIMAL(14,2), current_reserve DECIMAL(14,2), incurred DECIMAL(14,2), as_of_date DATE

edges.transform: lob_code + '/' + claim_number + '/' + handler_code (NULL handler gives NULL ref)
LEFT JOIN on policy_id at latest snapshot <= @AsOfDate
ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) per claim (fanned out by reserve join)
ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN reserve_type='INDEMNITY' THEN reserve_amount END),0)
ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN reserve_type='EXPENSE' THEN reserve_amount END),0)
CASE pivot by reserve_type feeding the sum
CASE pivot by reserve_type feeding the sum
JOIN to open claims on claim_id
ROW_NUMBER ORDER BY reserve_date DESC, keep rn=1

structured_output.notes: 1) Possible legacy bug (row fan-out): #money LEFT JOINs both claim_payments and #reserve on claim_id before GROUP BY (lines 109-115). A claim can have up to two reserve rows (INDEMNITY and EXPENSE), so SUM(p.amount) counts each payment once per reserve row, and total_paid and incurred can come out doubled. The migration must reproduce this behaviour to match the legacy output; n_payments is not affected because it uses COUNT(DISTINCT). 2) claim_ref is NULL whenever handler_code is NULL, because string concatenation with + returns NULL by default (CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL). 3) policy_number comes from the single latest snapshot_date on or before @AsOfDate across the whole table, picked into the variable @snapshot_date (lines 121-123). If a policy is missing from that snapshot, policy_number is NULL; the job does not fall back to an earlier snapshot. 4) Reserve types other than INDEMNITY or EXPENSE are dropped, and the reserve_date filter only changes the reserve values, not which claim rows appear. 5) The PARTITION BY claim_id, reserve_type in the reserve ROW_NUMBER is listed as a ranks edge with lower confidence (0.6). 6) The joins to #money and #reserve keep every open claim, so the output has one row per claim from stg.claims that passes the filters on lines 73-74.
